fidelity: F2a — Thevenin Equivalent-Circuit Model (1-RC/2-RC) with Coulomb-counted SOC and Bernardi thermal ODE
source: Liaw et al. (2003), J. Power Sources 119-121:874; Hu, Li & Peng (2012), J. Power Sources 198:359 (Thevenin ECM comparison); Bernardi et al. (1985), J. Electrochem. Soc. 132(1):5 (thermal energy balance); Forgez et al. (2010), J. Power Sources 195:2961 (entropic coeff); Vetter et al. (2005), J. Power Sources 147:269 (Mn dissolution aging)
note: Spinel LiMn2O4 OCV shows dual plateaus near 4.05 V and 3.95 V (two-stage Li (de)intercalation in the 8a tetrahedral sites). Aging context: Mn(III) disproportionation -> Mn2+ dissolution into electrolyte at high T/SOC drives capacity fade; not modelled dynamically in F2a (see F2c_ecm_aging) but motivates the conservative valid T-range.

n_rc.note: Number of RC pairs (1 or 2); selects 1-RC vs 2-RC Thevenin

coulombic_efficiency.note: Charge acceptance eta_c in (0,1); applied to charging current in SOC integration

E_a.note: Arrhenius activation energy for resistances (LMO spinel)
E_a.source: Ecker et al. (2015), J. Electrochem. Soc. 162(9):A1836

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient; LMO ~ -0.18 mV/K (less negative than NMC)
dOCV_dT.source: Forgez et al. (2010); Thomas & Newman (2003), J. Electrochem. Soc. 150:A176

hA_cool.note: Convective heat-transfer coeff * surface area (natural convection 18650)

ocv_a0.note: OCV(SOC)=sum a_i SOC^i, refit for full 3.0->4.2 V span

ocv_a5.note: Spinel dual-plateau OCV least-squares fit to Liaw et al. (2003) LMO curve; monotone increasing on [0,1], flat ~4.0 V plateau near mid-SOC

temperature.note: -20 to 60 degC; upper bound conservative due to Mn dissolution at high T
